lead: A new domain module is `mod`, not `pub mod`, so its `CLASS`/`NAME` are `pub(crate)`.
body: The workspace warns `unreachable_pub`, and half of `nvs-stdlib`'s modules are `pub mod` while the newer half is not, so copying `uuid.rs`'s `pub const NAME` into a privately-declared module is a warning at build time. `objmap.rs`'s `NAME` is the shape to copy.
